items.content_html: ICS Connect is a lightweight event planning and RSVP API for campus/community events. Built with FastAPI, it provides JWT auth, search, reservations with waitlists, and health checks. Pluggable repositories support in‑memory or SQL storage. Includes request logging, rate limiting, CORS, Docker, CI, and thorough tests.
